_hint: Default key binding for new players and for "Restore default". Existing sessions keep their own binding.
Layout: function -> key; several keys as a list, e.g. "B": ["y", "z"]. A function that is missing sits on no key.
Functions: A B X Y L R START SELECT UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT FAST_FORWARD MENU SWAP TOUCH (X, Y, SWAP and TOUCH only on the NDS).
Controller keys by position (Xbox label): SOUTH = A, EAST = B, WEST = X, NORTH = Y, L, R, L2, R2, STICK_L = L3, STICK_R = R3, START, SELECT, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT.
Keyboard keys with pygame names: a-z, 0-9, up, down, left, right, return, backspace, space, tab, left shift ...
Own default that survives updates: copy this file into the data folder (beside settings.json) and change it there.
